name: Kingdom of Hán (Eighteen Kingdoms)
alt: Kingdom of Hán under Xiang Yu

predecessors.name: Han (Warring States)
predecessors.text: the restored Hán of Han Cheng, whom Xiang Yu confirmed as king in 206

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: the Hán vassal kingdom at its last seat, Taiyuan Commandery with its capital at Jinyang, 201

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu makes Han Cheng King of Hán in the Eighteen Kingdoms.
Late 206: Xiang Yu kills Han Cheng and puts Zheng Chang on the throne of Hán.
205: Hán Xin, with Liu Bang's backing, replaces Zheng Chang and the kingdom passes to Liu Bang's side.
201: the Yingchuan lands are given up when the kingdom is relocated.
201: the Hán kingdom is relocated to Taiyuan Commandery, capital Jinyang (Hán Xin later asks for Mayi, approved).
201: the court moves from Yangzhai to Jinyang.
201: Hán Xin defects to the Xiongnu and the kingdom of Hán ends.

certainty.note: The kingdoms were assigned by Xiang Yu from commanderies, with no survey or treaty lines; the outline is Cliopatria's approximation and the Taiyuan year is a radius.

sources.title: Xin of Han (Xin, King of Hán)
